name: dsh-gitbash-shell
description: DSH plugin: run every agent shell command through Git for Windows bash on Windows instead of PowerShell. Replaces the pwsh executor with a Git Bash ctx.shell provider and materializes Git Bash variants of the standard/minimal/code/cordis agent presets into your user preset root at startup. On Windows it also adopts dsh-better-sidebar's terminal shell (UI tabs and the model-facing terminal_* tools) through the sidebar's official settings seam, and pairs with dsh-ptc-cordis-preset so the PTC Creation-mode preset materializes as its Git Bash variant.
